evals.name: evaluate-a-weak-idea
evals.prompt: One of my students wants to build an AI app that helps students study better. She's in grade 11 in Toronto and wants to enter a competition this year. Is this good enough?
evals.expected_output: Honest critique naming the specificity gap, anchored in a comparable finalist project, plus a concrete next step and a competition recommendation with dates.

evals.name: student-with-no-idea
evals.prompt: I'm running a 90-minute session on Saturday for eight teenagers who have never started anything. None of them have an idea. What do I actually do with them?
evals.expected_output: A runnable session plan using one extraction method, with real precedent examples and a closing task, not generic brainstorming advice.

evals.name: competition-routing
evals.prompt: My kid built a working prototype of a device that detects mould in apartment walls and tested it in six units. Which competition should he enter and when does he need to start?
evals.expected_output: Routes to Conrad on validation grounds, cites the relevant deadline, flags the fee and the January collision, and notes he could enter more than one.
